highlight_en: Open-air deck on the 4th floor of the domestic terminal, open 8:00 to 20:00 from April to November; the Rapidus IIM-1 fab is visible across the runway (per a local blog).
notes: Official page: open Apr 1-Nov 30, 8:00-20:00, closed Dec-Mar; closes in strong wind or snow; binoculars 100 yen per use (~100 s). Entry fee not stated on official page, but binoculars are the only charge listed and secondary sites say entry is free. Enter from the 3rd-floor food mall or beside the Airport History Museum. Rapidus IIM-1 (red-brown building) seen across the runway: Chitose real-estate blog dated 2026-05-01 (https://areanet.estate/staffblog/25432/), not official. Duration 30 min is our estimate. Closed for all of Dec-Mar, so only usable Apr-Nov. Official image is only 342 px wide.
